_about: 注: knowledge figures, each defined once, keyed by id. The book writes [words]{注=id}; the reader (scripts/read-md.js) shows the figure beside that paragraph. image is under this world folder; lines are 2–3 short lines; credit and source say where the picture is from.
_marks: The animation layer (scripts/marks.js): ratio = the image's height/width; points [{id, label, x, y}] and paths [{id, d: [[x, y]…], through: [point ids, in flow order]}], x/y in 0–1 of the image, drawn as an SVG over it.

zh: 督脉沿脊背上行。小周天的气，从这里往上走。
要过三道关：尾闾在尾骨尖，夹脊在两肩胛之间，玉枕在后脑。
《内经图》画的就是这条脊背：下起尾闾，上到头顶的群峰。
en: The Du channel runs up the spine; the small circuit's qi climbs it.
Three passes bar the way: Weilü at the tailbone, Jiaji between the shoulder blades, Yuzhen at the back of the head.
The Neijing Tu draws this spine: from Weilü at the foot to the peaks of the head.

credit.zh: 《内经图》，北京白云观碑拓本，光绪十二年（1886）。公有领域。
credit.en: Neijing Tu, rubbing of the Baiyun Guan stele, Beijing, 1886. Public domain.
